claims.evidence: Witness could not read model or storage label; only generic Xbox logo visible, no back/bottom sticker shown
Photo 0 and Photo 1 show a black wireless controller resting on the console
No screenshot of dashboard, game library, or storage menu was captured

risks.risk: Console may not power on or may have internal fault (overheating, disc drive failure)
risks.proof: Video of console powering on to dashboard and reading a disc

risks.risk: Storage capacity may differ from claimed 1TB (could be 500GB base model)
risks.proof: Photo of rear/bottom serial sticker or in-console storage settings screen

risks.risk: Disc drive or HDMI/USB ports may be damaged or non-functional
risks.proof: Close-up photo/video of ports and a test disc being read

risks.risk: Power cable, HDMI cable, or second controller may not be included despite implication
risks.proof: Full photo of all included accessories laid out together
risks.if_unproven: priced as console + one controller only, no cables

risks.risk: Hidden cosmetic damage (scratches, dents, cracks) on unseen sides
risks.proof: Photos of top, bottom, back, and underside of console

risks.risk: 'Games installed' may refer to pirated/jailbroken software or shared account, risking bans
risks.proof: Screenshot of dashboard showing legitimate licensed library or account ownership
risks.if_unproven: priced as console-only value, games disregarded

proof_requests: Video of console powering on and loading a game/dashboard
Clear photo of rear/bottom label showing model number and storage capacity
Close-up photos of all ports (HDMI, USB, power) and disc tray
Photo of all accessories together: power cable, HDMI cable, controller(s)
Screenshot of the console's storage/settings menu showing installed games and free space
response.reason: Witness confirms it is a genuine Xbox console with one controller, so it can be priced, but model, storage, functionality, and accessory completeness are unverified and must be assumed worst-case until proven.
